title: Lot C in May
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Lot C in May: the spruce dropping pollen on every windshield, yellow, drawn as gray. Wood writes the digest's name in the pollen on the Datsun's hood. The guard reads it. Says he thought it was Wood's name. Everyone does.

panels.composition: Lot C, May, every car dusted with pollen. The Datsun. WOOD's finger on the hood.

image.prompt: a parking lot in spring with every car dusted in pollen, a young man writing with a finger on a small car's hood, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The hood: DRIFT WOOD, written in the pollen in the display face.

image.prompt: close on two words written in the pollen dust on a car's hood in squared capitals, black and white, no words
image.notes: Letter after: DRIFT WOOD (in the pollen).

image.prompt: a security guard pausing to read words written in dust on a car's hood, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Rain starting. The words running. The guard walking on. By the time Wood's back the hood's clean. The strip kept it.

image.prompt: rain beginning to fall on a pollen-dusted car hood, the finger-written words starting to run, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: Written in pollen, rained off. 'Everyone does.' The strip kept it.
